**SQL：**
```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) AS female_client_accounts_south_bohemia
FROM clnt c
JOIN dsp d ON c.clnt_id = d.ref1
JOIN acct a ON d.ref2 = a.accn_id
JOIN dstr ds ON a.ref1 = ds.dstr_id
WHERE c.gndr = 'F' AND ds.a3 = 'south Bohemia'
```

女性客户在 South Bohemia 地区的账户数为 **231**。

runs.final_sql: SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(ln.dt)=1997 THEN ln.amnt ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(ln.dt)=1996 THEN ln.amnt ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(ln.dt)=1996 THEN ln.amnt ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate FROM clnt c JOIN dsp d ON d.ref1 = c.clnt_id AND d.typ = 'OWNER' JOIN acct a ON a.accn_id = d.ref2 JOIN ln ON ln.ref1 = a.accn_id WHERE c.gndr = 'M' AND YEAR(ln.dt) IN (1996, 1997)
sql_history: SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(ln.dt)=1997 THEN ln.amnt ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(ln.dt)=1996 THEN ln.amnt ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(ln.dt)=1996 THEN ln.amnt ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate FROM clnt c JOIN dsp d ON d.ref1 = c.clnt_id AND d.typ = 'OWNER' JOIN acct a ON a.accn_id = d.ref2 JOIN ln ON ln.ref1 = a.accn_id WHERE c.gndr = 'M' AND YEAR(ln.dt) IN (1996, 1997)
runs.agent_text:
增长率为 **25.30%**。

```sql
SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(ln.dt)=1997 THEN ln.amnt ELSE 0 END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(ln.dt)=1996 THEN ln.amnt ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
      / SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(ln.dt)=1996 THEN ln.amnt ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate
FROM clnt c
JOIN dsp  d ON d.ref1 = c.clnt_id AND d.typ = 'OWNER'
JOIN acct a ON a.accn_id = d.ref2
JOIN ln    ON ln.ref1 = a.accn_id
WHERE c.gndr = 'M' AND YEAR(ln.dt) IN (1996, 1997);
```

结果：**25.30019**（约 **25.30%**）
- 口径：男性客户（gender='M'）作为账户拥有者（OWNER），经 dsp→acct 关联其名下所有账户的贷款
- 增长率 = (1997 年贷款总额 − 1996 年贷款总额) / 1996 年贷款总额 × 100%
